issue.title: Retry logic is duplicated across provider adapters
issue.body:
## Problem

Each provider adapter reimplements its own retry loop, so a change to the backoff policy has to be made in five places and they have already drifted apart.

## Why it matters

Inconsistent retries cause flaky behavior under provider rate limits, and the drift means some providers retry on errors that others treat as fatal.

## Proposed direction

Centralize retry in a single bridge layer that every provider call passes through.
